name: sheet-21
description: Sheet with a fixed header and footer around a long scrollable changelog.

files.content:
import { RssIcon, ScrollTextIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { ScrollArea } from "@workspace/ui/components/scroll-area" import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/sheet" const entries = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => ({ version: "3." + (12 - i) + ".0", date: "Week " + (48 - i), notes: [ "Improved sync reliability for offline edits", "New keyboard shortcuts in the editor", "Fixed a crash when importing large spreadsheets", ].slice(0, (i % 3) + 1), })) export default function ChangelogScrollSheet() { return ( }> Changelog Changelog Every release from the past quarter.
{entries.map((entry) => (
v{entry.version} {entry.date}
    {entry.notes.map((note) => (
  • {note}
    • ))}
))}
) }
